name: @obsign/sdk
description: Obsign SDK — offline receipt verification, a REST/x402 API client, and a viem-based pinned chain reader (INV-6). @obsign/core is bundled so the published package verifies offline with no workspace dependency.

scripts.prepublishOnly: node -e "console.error('Do not publish @obsign/sdk directly (its base manifest points at src for the monorepo). Run: npm run publish:sdk'); process.exit(1)"
